transcript: I was 18 when I wrote a book about LinkedIn, and 7 years later, I'm in New York for a LinkedIn event as the only Indian to go there. Hi, I'm Ishan, 25 from Bengaluru. I interviewed the CMO of LinkedIn and then went on to organize an event for LinkedIn in Bangalore. And the quote of the day is, you miss 100% of the shots you don't take. I still remember the amount of mockery I got from my college batchmates when I launched my first book. Who are you to publish a book? What do you know about LinkedIn? I would have never reached here if I listened to them, if I played life logically and safe. In the words of GaryVee, do it. Whatever that was that just came through your
